chapter: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: One Hundred Sights of Dihua
act_title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: One Hundred Sights of Dihua

quests.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: One Hundred Sights of Dihua

dialogue.t: Ooh. The sea here is pretty.
Eh? Dihua Marsh isn't a sea.

dialogue.sit: Its waters are connected to the sea, though...

dialogue.t: Hmm, that's true... but it still feels wrong to call Dihua Marsh the sea.
Mm... Not really understanding. "Sea" and "Not the Sea," what's the difference?

dialogue.sit: The taste of the water?
The sea is a large-scale water body beyond the mainland.
These concepts are all man-made constructs. They don't have inherent meaning.

dialogue.t: Ooh! Forest water is a bit sweet, so not the sea!
But if Cider Lake is full of cider, what would it count as...?

dialogue.sit: Something Venti would truly love.

dialogue.t: That issue aside, though. Is it just Paimon, or is Kichiboushi getting better at speaking?

dialogue.sit: According to what Ioroi said before...
Ioroi did say something about this before we left...

dialogue.t: What did Ioroi say again? "I am the renowned bake-danuki, Ioroi"... Uh, no, that's not it...
"Ooh... I do so wish to scratch mine belly." "Oh...!" Hmm, that's not it, either.
Mmhaha, Paimon good at imitator. Very funny!

dialogue.sit: "As we get more used to Kichiboushi's aura..."

dialogue.t: Oh yeah, that's right! The more used we are to Kichiboushi's aura, the better we'll be able to understand him!
And training, mm! Kichiboushi going with {NICKNAME} and Paimon, learning lots of new things!

dialogue.sit: Paimon's a good guide, eh?
Companions who adventure together, grow together.

dialogue.t: Oh...
You remember all that from back then, huh, {NICKNAME}? That's nice of you...
Mm! Thank you, Paimon and {NICKNAME}.
This "is-or-isn't-a-sea" is very pretty. The tall, tall house behind it is very pretty too. Help Kichiboushi taking a photo?

dialogue.sit: Leave it to me.

dialogue.t: And it's done!
Next up...
How about this? Kichiboushi, have you ever gone fishing?
Fishing?
Looks like you haven't. Alright then, let's head for the water's edge!
Yey!
Ooh... Why...
Come on, Kichiboushi, why did you just charge straight into the hilichurl stronghold?
Thought we could... play...
Eh? Why? The hilichurls are dangerous monsters...

dialogue.sit: Now, I wouldn't call them dangerous...
Aye, they're truly perilous!

dialogue.t: Come on! Kichiboushi isn't anywhere as seasoned a combatant as you!

dialogue.sit: Hmm, when we first met in Chinju Forest...

dialogue.t: That's right! Weren't you hiding in the form of some other object while being surrounded by hilichurls?
When we first met... First met... I'm thinking... Ooh, yes.
Then, was playing Hide-and-Seek with the hilichurl. Forest hilichurls do not attack bake-danuki. They play with us often.
Eh? So you've developed a harmonious relationship?
Not knowing why the hilichurls here are like this. Mmm...
Either way, you need to be more careful out here. Even when it comes to hilichurls... Well, especially when it comes to the hilichurls...
Ugh, this is getting complicated. You explain, {NICKNAME}.

dialogue.sit: You need to differentiate between the good people and the bad.

dialogue.t: Yup! That's how you can protect yourself in the future.

dialogue.sit: But don't forget to keep a good and open heart.

dialogue.t: Yup, that's right! That'll help you enjoy the good things in life!
Mm...
{NICKNAME} and Paimon say complicated things. Kichiboushi not understand.
But Kichiboushi knows you're good people. So Kichiboushi learn.
Alright, enough of that for now. For now, time to learn how to fish from {NICKNAME}.
Mm! Fishing!
Haha, this place looks pretty good.
Kichiboushi wants to play with water!
Hey, hey, not now! You'll scare the fish away!

dialogue.sit:
You teach Kichiboushi the basics of fishing.
You try to keep things simple, but as to how much he understands...

dialogue.t: Fish!

dialogue.sit: Got it?

dialogue.t: Mmhaha! Fish are silly. Get tricked by food!

dialogue.sit: Huh, that sounds like Paimon!
You're not so different, Kichiboushi.
That happens to me too.

dialogue.t: Hey, come on!
Well, everyone likes gourmet food!
Well then, {NICKNAME}, time to show Kichiboushi what you can do!
Really to play with the water.

dialogue.sit: Not now, you'll scare the fish off.

dialogue.t: Mm. Okay.
Hmm. Why not go into water to catchy fish?

dialogue.sit: Some fish can't be caught that way.
It might be quite troublesome, but it's more interesting this way.
This is also a form of training.

dialogue.t: That's right! Fishing is a great way to train!

dialogue.sit: You try, Kichiboushi.
You try, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Mm?

dialogue.sit:
In the end, Kichiboushi is the one to try fishing.
As expected, he doesn't catch much of anything.
In the end, the three of you give up fishing and play by the water instead.

dialogue.t: Being damp at all kinda sucks, but it was pretty fun to play in the water!
Kichiboushi is very happy! But fishing is hard.
Yup. But if you do learn to fish, you might make some unexpected friends some day. Right, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: That's true.
Yes, though food expenses might increase as a result.

dialogue.t: Hard to understand... But Kichiboushi understands.
Playing with {NICKNAME} and Paimon is very fun. {NICKNAME} and Paimon are Kichiboushi's good friends.
Training is great!
Oh yeah, speaking of which, Ioroi's goal was to take Kichiboushi to eight places to train...
Dragonspine, Guyun Stone Forest, Mondstadt, Liyue Harbor, Mt. Hulao... We've finished most of your training already!
Mm, that's true...
So where should we go next?

dialogue.sit: I'll leave that decision to you.

dialogue.t: Ooh, that's not something Paimon hears from you often, {NICKNAME}!
Alright, then! Leave this to Paimon!
Leave it to Paimon, mm!

quests.description: You agreed to Ioroi’s request to “bring Kichiboushi out to train.” Time to show him the unique sights of Liyue’s Dihua Marsh.
